title: S10b - wire cnn-v2 into the official chain (stacked on S7c): confidence-gated fallback, three-run proof, promote only on measured gain
desc: Scope: S10 landed glyphcnn-v2 (31/100 easy, 8/100 hard as a whole reader, merged a3ab207). This task is the WIRING the S10 brief asked for: feed low-confidence glyphs of the official chain through the v2 CNN as the gated fallback, then re-bench OFFICIALLY (easy+hard, seed 1, hash b2c460d2fb5a), three runs, before/after. Promote only if it beats the floor on the official suites - a val gain is not a suite gain (S10's own lesson). HARD RULE: baseline.py is marcus's desk while S7c (e105) is open. Do not push baseline.py. Stack your branch on his S7c branch and coordinate merge order on the bus; if that is blocked for more than ~30 min, switch to the decision layer with barry (case/spacing on already-correct glyph streams), distinct files, no collisions. Numbers measured and labeled; keep the truth anchor.
